_instructions: OPERATOR SETUP — copy this file to appsettings.json on each client laptop and fill in
the placeholders below. Do NOT commit the filled-in file — it is listed in .gitignore.
Each client laptop must have its own copy with the correct Server IP/hostname.
Set NTFS permissions so only the running Windows user account can read it.

ConnectionStrings._comment: Replace <HOST-IP-OR-NAME> with the LAN IP or hostname of the XAMPP host laptop.

Connection._comment_HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: Seconds between health checks while Online. Default 15.
Connection._comment_RetryBackoffSeconds: Seconds to wait before each reconnect attempt (5 values = 5 retries).
Connection._comment_MaxRetries: Number of reconnect attempts before transitioning to Offline.

Client._comment_WorkstationName: Unique name for this client laptop. Used in log triage. Examples: Cashier-1, Cashier-2, Manager-Office, Owner-Office.
